Cinematic 10-second dramatic close-up, over-the-shoulder shot. A beautiful young woman in a flowing red hanfu, with long black hair and an ornate golden hair crown and long dangling gold earrings, stands on a muddy battlefield after a battle. Misty mountains and a dark pine forest are behind her under an overcast grey sky. In the right foreground, a tall warrior in dark armor and a black fur collar stands with his back to the camera, softly out of focus.

0–2s: She looks up at him with teary, trembling eyes. Her lips quiver, and a gentle wind blows loose strands of hair across her face.
2–4s: She takes a shaky breath, swallows, and steps slightly closer to him, her eyes glistening.
4–8s: With a voice full of emotion, holding back tears, she speaks softly to him with accurate lip-sync: "You promised me you would come back... Why did you choose this war over me?"
8–10s: A single tear rolls down her cheek. She keeps looking into his eyes, waiting for an answer, as the wind moves her hair and red sleeves.

Very slow push-in on her face, shallow depth of field, soft diffused natural light, muted cold color grading with her red dress as the focal color, emotional Chinese historical drama style, realistic micro-expressions, 4K, film grain, 24fps.

## pi-H3 DWD: MiniMax H3 video in 2 or 4 steps (RDNA4)

pi-H3 (Lakonik) distills MiniMax H3 FL2VA into a 2- or 4-step generator. DWD adapters predict the video pixels directly at the last step, so the video skips the VAE decoder. Text to video, or first frame / last frame / both (enable the Load Image + Resize nodes and connect them to MiniMax H3 Image to Video).

**Measured on the R9700** (1344x768, 5 s, 2 steps): **47 s warm** (2 x 19.7 s + save), 102 s cold. 27 GB VRAM, 44 GB RAM. The previous H3 I2V workflow (8 steps, 0.9 MP) takes about 225 s.

**Steps**: set `steps` (2 or 4) on the *pi-H3 Adapter (2 or 4 steps)* node; it picks the adapter and the pi-Flow Scheduler settings (max_raw_t 0.93 / 0.96, final_step_size_scale 0.6).

### Custom nodes
- **ComfyUI-piFlow**: https://github.com/Lakonik/ComfyUI-piFlow (pi-Flow Scheduler, Load LakonLab Adapter, DWD Decode). Install: `cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes && git clone https://github.com/Lakonik/ComfyUI-piFlow` (tested at commit 0fcf387).
- **ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel** (ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel): https://github.com/penguinhelmet/ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel - Text Encoder BF16, and the fix that lets the DWD head run on AMD (the H3 decoder norm_out cast; without it: "expected scalar type BFloat16 but found Half").
- Everything else is core ComfyUI (MiniMax H3 nodes, Sparse Attention, Resolution Selector, Create/Save Video).

### Models (folder: path inside it)
- `diffusion_models/minimax-h3/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`
  https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
- `loras/pi-h3/pi_h3_2step_dwd_adapter_int8_convrot.safetensors`
  https://huggingface.co/Lakonik/pi-H3/resolve/main/pi_h3_2step_dwd_adapter_int8_convrot.safetensors
- `loras/pi-h3/pi_h3_4step_dwd_adapter_int8_convrot.safetensors`
  https://huggingface.co/Lakonik/pi-H3/resolve/main/pi_h3_4step_dwd_adapter_int8_convrot.safetensors
- `text_encoders/minimax-h3/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors`
  https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
- `vae/minimax-h3/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors` (only encodes the first / last frame)
  https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors
- `vae/minimax-h3/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors`
  https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors


### Notes
- Sparse attention is ComfyUI's built-in Sol (Sparse Attention node, INT8). The author says it is a little worse than Kijai's BF16 Sol (ComfyUI-SolAttn_triton, needs Triton; not tested on ROCm). Bypass it for dense attention (slower, best quality).
- Prompt format: H3 fields (`integrated_multimodal_description:` / `overall_soundscape:` / `non_diegetic_music:`); the prompt workflows in `04-prompt` write them.
- License: pi-H3 adapters follow the MiniMax H3 Community License.
